description: On a well-ordered linear order, every family of total rules on earlier histories with fixed value type S determines exactly one function A → S satisfying the rules.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.recursion_exists_unique.{u, v} {α : Type u} {S : Type v} [LinearOrder α] [WellFoundedLT α]
  (Φ : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.RecursionRule α S) : ∃! F, ∀ (a : α), F a = Φ a fun b => F ↑b
